svg.title: Matching AGVs to root tray moves
svg.desc: AssignAgvs builds an AGV-by-TrayMove cost table for the current root events and runs BottleneckAssignment; infeasible pairs get no edge.
svg.metadata: ["One outer iteration of AssignAgvs: the root TrayMoves are e4 (T15 -> P19) and e1 (T21 -> P23); the candidate AGVs are AGV-1, AGV-2 and AGV-3. The cost table is still empty.", "ComputeAgvAssignmentCost(AGV-1, e4): AGV-1 drives from W26 to T15 on P15 and lifts it, about 41 s.", "AGV-1 -> e1: AGV-1 drives to T21 in bay B21, about 48 s.", "AGV-2 -> e4: AGV-2 at W18 is close to P15, about 19 s, the cheapest pair.", "AGV-2 -> e1: AGV-2 drives to B21, about 36 s.", "AGV-3 already carries T24, so the cost function returns nullopt for both moves and AGV-3 gets no edge.", "BottleneckAssignment minimises the largest cost used. With only edges <= 19 s (AGV-2/e4) it can match one move, not two.", "Raise the limit to 36 s: AGV-2/e4 and AGV-2/e1 both need AGV-2, so still only one move can be matched.", "At 41 s, AGV-1/e4 joins and {AGV-1/e4, AGV-2/e1} matches both moves; the threshold is 41 s. The cheaper total {AGV-2/e4 19 s, AGV-1/e1 48 s} loses because its worst pair is 48 s.", "The matching goes to BuildAgvOrderDag(), which orders matched AGVs whose paths would collide; then each pair is expanded into AGV events (the green legs show the drives to the trays).", "Playing the plan: AGV-1 drives from W26 to P15 and stops under T15, the tray of e4.", "AGV-2 drives from W18 past W22 and W41 into bay B21 and stops under T21, the tray of e1. The two drives share no node, so BuildAgvOrderDag() adds no order between them."]

g.text: // cost(agv, move) = max(busy(agv) - earliest_start(move), 0) + travel(agv.pose -> tray.pose) + lift_up

g.text: edge_costs[{agv_id, root_event}] = ComputeAgvAssignmentCost(agv_id, *tray_move, working_state, agv_wait, path_filter);

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: auto assignment_opt = BottleneckAssignment(edge_costs, available_agv_ids, root_events, Interval::Duration::max());
